# Anniversary Transfers for Hardcore & Classic Era Close January 12th
Luxrah [Luxrah](https://www.warcrafttavern.com/participant/luxrah/) • Published January 7, 2026
There’s a lot of news for WoW Classic Anniversary Edition today with the announcement of the [February 5th launch date](https://www.warcrafttavern.com/tbc/news/the-burning-crusade-launches-on-february-5-for-wow-classic-anniversary-edition/) , [standalone level 58 boosts
that include blood elves and draenei](https://www.warcrafttavern.com/tbc/news/blood-elf-draenei-will-be-eligible-for-boosts-in-the-tbc-pre-patch/) , and a [24-hour extended maintenance ahead of next week’s
pre-patch](https://www.warcrafttavern.com/tbc/news/24-hour-maintenance-scheduled-for-tbc-anniversary-pre-patch-january-12/) .

...

This includes **transfers from Anniversary to Classic Era** for those who wish to stay in the vanilla version of the game, as well as **transfers between Hardcore Anniversary and Normal Anniversary** **realms** for those who want to progress their Hardcore characters into
TBC. There will not be a Hardcore version of The Burning Crusade, so characters who remain on Hardcore realms will continue with the vanilla game alongside Classic Era characters.
